page.layout: One printed page (page 51, right side of the opening). One column of running text, with marginal notes in the right margin. Running head at top, page number at top right. Gathering signature at bottom left and catchword at bottom right. Partial text at the left edge belongs to the facing page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: Sub Ottone I. maxima Imperii Germanici potentia3. Poten-tiam sub Ot-tone I. fuit.
main_text.head: Explicatio:
main_text.p: Otto I. à rebus gestis Magnus appellatus collapsam Imperii post Carolum M. dignitatem restituit. Sub ipsius nepote Ottone III. instituti Electores putantur; quanquam nihil certi eâ de re constet.
Miserrima Germaniæ con-4. Sta-tū tem-pore vacenalis[?] interre-gniditio fuit post mortem Friderici II. durante interregno.
main_text.head: Explicatio.
main_text.p: Extinctâ Friderici II. familiâ, Germania XXII. continuos annos Imperatore caruit. Unde mira pas-sim confusio, latrocinia vaga, & quicquid malorum remotô à Republ. capite oriri solet.

page.notes: Left-edge text belongs to the facing page and was omitted. "Canon 7." and "Canon 8" are numbered canons, so they are written as paragraphs; the "8" is doubtful (it looks like a § shape). Note 4 reads "vacenalis" with a doubtful letter after "va" (possibly "vacantis" or similar); marked [?]. The note 3 hyphenation is as printed. Mixed italic and roman in the body was reproduced from the scan. "XXII." and "Ottone III." are copied as printed. The original reads "qvicqvid", normalised to "quicquid" under the u/v rule. The "Explicatio" headings are level 2 titles above passages.
